channel_a_10x_steady_usb_measurement.measurement_interpretation: At 10x the calculated value changes materially with scope input range: ~0.764V tip at +/-5V input but ~0.085V at +/-0.5V input. Raw ADC codes stay near 2 native 8-bit steps in both ranges, so the coarse reading likely reflects scope ADC offset/quantization rather than a proven 0.764V net voltage. The sensitive +/-0.5V input run saw maximum 0.131V tip and no samples >0.5V during 4x498.4ms windows. Probe short-to-verified-board-GND zero measurement, and ideally known 3V3 reference, are necessary before treating any reading as absolute. No reset/BOOTSEL/brownout, actual KNX power, current, or U9 electrical/thermal validation.
